prompt_md: How many people must be in a room to be certain that at least three of them were born on the same day of the week?
prompt_short: People needed to be sure 3 share a birth weekday?
hint_md: How many people can you have with no three sharing a weekday?
explain_intuition_md: You can fit 14 people with exactly two per weekday and still have no three matching. The 15th person has to make a third somewhere. 21 would be three on every day, far more than you need.
